subject: Error in read.capthist for multiple sessions

messages.author: 1e55c83b1f50d96a
messages.subject: Error in read.capthist for multiple sessions
parts:
Hi,

I am trying run read.capthist for a multisession model using polygon detectors but I got this error message below

> CH_c <- read.capthist(captfile = "c_capt.txt", trapfile = "c_poly.txt", fmt = "XY", detector = "polygon")
Error in 1:nrow(xy) : argument of length 0

I also have quite a few polygons that don't have any detections, so in my capture history .txt file the AnimalID is listed as "NONE' but the xy coordinates are listed as two 0s which I'm not sure is correct.

Any help is much appreciated!

Best,

Malcolm
